nd256053772.headline: South African Data Supports Gordhan’s Dismissal of Recession
nd256053772.summary: Data showed South Africa’s current account deficit narrowed more than expected in the second quarter, supporting the finance minister’s view that the economy is avoiding recession.
nd256053772.why: South Africa is Africa’s largest economy; current account improvements reduce external vulnerabilities and influence currency and bond markets.
nd256053772.why_moved: Better-than-expected current account data supports positive economic sentiment, impacting currency and bond markets.
